antigens.source_commit: fix: pagination dropped the last item of every page (#41)
antigens.title: #41 Off-by-one in slice end
antigens.pattern: slice(start, start + n - 1) drops the last element of each page

code.explain: slice() end adjusted by 1: check that full pages keep their last item

signatures.fix_hint: The end index of slice() is exclusive, so use slice(start, start + size) with no - 1.
signatures.antibody: Concatenate every page for many list and page sizes, and assert the result equals the full list.

patches.explain: drop the '- 1': slice()'s end index is already exclusive (the #41 fix)

antigens.source_commit: fix: invoice totals off by a cent due to float math (#63)
antigens.title: #63 Float money math
antigens.pattern: summing currency as floats instead of integer cents

code.explain: money summed as floating-point numbers instead of integer cents
money multiplied as floats without rounding to cents

signatures.fix_hint: Convert to integer cents first: Math.round(price * 100) * qty, sum the cents, and divide by 100 once at the end.
signatures.antibody: Sum every cent value from 0.01 to 0.99, alone and in pairs, and assert exact results.

patches.explain: sum in integer cents and divide once (the #63 fix)
